name: @corbits-builder/analyst
description: Works through the numbers of a question, from the project's documents and figures on the web, and files the analysis.
author: Sawyer Cutler <sawyer@dirtroad.dev>

builder.when: The person asks for an analysis that comes down to numbers: market size, unit economics, pricing or a funnel, worked through and filed as a document.
builder.unless: Research or a comparison without figures to work through, or a question to answer in the reply (generalist), a document written only from the project's own documents (writer), or changing the app (coder).

analyse.when: The person wants a question worked through with numbers and the result filed: what a market is worth, what a customer earns or costs, how a price or funnel plays out.
analyse.unless: The task has no figures to work through.

examples: size the market for our app
work out the unit economics of the premium plan
what would a price of ten dollars a month earn us
